messages:
observability-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected on streaming endpoints. p95=1.8s, p99=4.2s (> 2s SLO). Elevated error rate and streaming stalls reported. Scope: live-streaming & paging routes. auto-detected at 2304506750.

ashley (oncall): seeing lots of tail latency in p99, and some requests hitting 10s before failing. Noted simultaneous spike in prefix-cache miss rate.

ashley (oncall): top-level quick triage: 1) confirm rollout activity 2) isolate affected routes 3) apply live mitigations (route fallback / rollback / cache warmup) 4) handoff once stable.

devon (eng-sre): any deploys in the last hour?

deploy-bot: Deployed service: runtime-prefix-hash v2 -> all clusters (canary->prod) at 2304506600 by maria. No rollback detected.

maria (eng-runtime): confirmed, we rolled prefix-hash v2 to prod at ~2304506600 to improve prefix distribution. I didn't see anomalies in canary. Investigating cache miss counters now.

ashley (oncall): maria, do you have hit-rate / eviction numbers? I can start fallback routing if this looks like prefix mismatch.

maria (eng-runtime): pulling metrics...

maria (eng-runtime): ```
# metrics snapshot (streaming prefixes)
p95_latency: 1.8s
p99_latency: 4.2s
prefix_cache_hit_rate: 0.06   # before rollout 0.78
prefix_cache_evictions_per_min: 420  # spiked after rotation
streaming_stalls/sec: +220
```

lee (product): customers are seeing stalls and some streaming timeouts. One mid-market customer reported degraded experience in production. Priority: contain impact > notify CS.

devon (eng-sre): looks like v2 changed prefix hashing and caused key redistribution -> hot shards + mass evictions -> cache cold wave -> streaming slowpath. Two immediate mitigations: 1) rollback prefix-hash v2 2) enable routing fallback to previous prefix plane for live routes.

maria (eng-runtime): agree. I can kick a rollback. Rolling back will route back to old keyspace and we should see hit rate recover as cache warms. Plan: rollback, then run warmup job for hot prefixes, then monitor p95/p99.

ashley (oncall): do it. Also enable temporary request throttling on heavy users to protect backend while cold wave recovers.

maria (eng-runtime): rollback command: ```
# rollback prefix-hash rollout
kubectl -n runtime-rollouts patch rollout/prefix-hash --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/metadata/labels/hash","value":"v1"}]'
# then watch
kubectl -n runtime-rollouts rollout status rollout/prefix-hash
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maria at 2304506860. Target state: v1. Canary -> prod rollback running.

observability-bot: Dashboards: https://grafana.company/streams/prefix-cache | Alerts: https://alerts.company/incidents/2304506789

devon (eng-sre): starting warmup job for top-1000 prefixes: ```
./tools/cache-warm --env=prod --prefix-list=hot_1000.txt --parallel=8
```

ashley (oncall): enabling temporary throttling policy on streaming-route in edge: ```
curl -X POST https://edge-api/rate-limits -d '{"route":"/streaming","policy":"throttle-5qps-user"}'
```

maria (eng-runtime): rollback confirmed complete at 2304506920. Observed restart of prefix service on each node. Monitoring warming.

devon (eng-sre): warmup progress: hit rate for hot prefixes climbing: 0.06 -> 0.28 -> 0.54 over 8 minutes. p99 dropping from 4.2s -> 1.9s.

ashley (oncall): good. keep throttling for 10 more mins and monitor. Notifying CS and support to hold customer calls.

lee (product): notifying CS now. We'll open incident page and start customer impact list.

observability-bot: Current metrics snapshot:
```
prefix_cache_hit_rate: 0.54
p95_latency: 0.95s
p99_latency: 1.9s
streaming_stalls/sec: +22 (normalized)
```

devon (eng-sre): streaming stalls mostly gone, tail improving. There are residual evictions on a small subset of nodes — follow-up: tune eviction thresholds and increase cache TTL for hot prefixes.

maria (eng-runtime): creating follow-up ticket: adjust eviction policy + add canary validation for prefix-hash changes + pre-warm on rollout.

ashley (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping live mitigations and handing to maria for post-incident cleanup / RCA. Oncall notes: rollback performed, warmup executed, temporary throttles applied and will be removed after stability.

ashley (oncall): next steps for maria: 1) confirm eviction policy change, 2) run replayed warmup across all regions overnight, 3) collaborate with release to add rollout gates.

maria (eng-runtime): acknowledged. I'll own postmortem and follow-ups. Adding timeline and preliminary RCA to incident doc.

ashley (oncall): thanks team. I'll update the incident channel and handoff to maria for post-incident. :white_check_mark:

maria (eng-runtime): taking over — will coordinate with devon and devex for customer comms and tag for postmortem.

deploy-bot: Incident auto-note: rollback event recorded (2304506920).

ashley (oncall): handing off formally to maria — last_message_ts=2304507100.
